title: On-behalf-of: a token minted for the MCP server
lede: The gateway swaps the caller's verified token (RFC 8693) for one minted for the downstream server, so the backend validates a token issued to it. The act claim says who the original caller was. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

steps.title: The agent calls the gateway
steps.what: The call carries a token issued to the caller, aud = the gateway.

steps.title: The gateway exchanges the token
steps.what: Subject token in, a token for the downstream MCP server out. The issuer checks the subject token.

steps.title: A token minted for the MCP server
steps.what: aud is the MCP server, the lifetime is short, and the act claim names the original caller.

steps.title: The gateway calls the MCP server
steps.what: The backend receives a token issued to it, not a shared service-account token.

steps.title: The backend verifies it itself
steps.what: Signature, issuer, audience, expiry and act are checked by the backend. In Live mode this is real.
